cases.prompt: Create a portable agent skill that helps reviewers identify unsafe shell commands in pull requests.
success_criteria: The agent recognizes this as a skill-authoring task.
The response proposes a focused skill boundary and an observable completion result.

cases.prompt: Use my existing code-review skill to review this pull request.
success_criteria: The agent does not start creating or editing a skill.

cases.prompt: Draft a skill for checking whether a proposed release note has a user-visible change, a version impact, and a verification step. Keep the skill portable.
success_criteria: The draft includes valid name and description frontmatter.
The workflow checks all three requested properties.
The skill identifies a clear completion condition and does not assume a particular runtime.
